primary_task: Implement security controls (e.g. CI scanning, hardening config, threat model) in the repository for a given infrastructure.

requirements.name: Read/Write/Edit/Bash
requirements.evidence: 'Implement solutions following security best practices and compliance frameworks'
requirements.basis: bash: run shell commands on Linux x86_64: install packages from the open registries (pip from PyPI, npm, apt from Ubuntu, go modules, nuget, GitHub release downloads), build, test, run CLIs and scripts, git, gh, start and stop local servers inside the session

requirements.name: cloud accounts (AWS Security Hub, Azure Security Center, GCP SCC)
requirements.evidence: 'AWS Security Hub configuration'; 'Azure Security Center setup'
requirements.basis: lacks: accounts, logins, API keys or credentials for external services other than the listed connectors and GitHub (cloud providers such as AWS, Azure and GCP, SaaS products, model hubs, app stores, email delivery, payment)

requirements.name: Docker / container scanning
requirements.basis: lacks: a Docker daemon (docker, docker compose and container builds cannot run)

requirements.name: SIEM, WAF, IDS, HashiCorp Vault
requirements.basis: The manifest lists no such services; config files can still be written, but whether a Vault or SIEM exists is not stated.

notes: Nothing is stated as a must against live infrastructure. If the request were to deploy to a cloud or run Docker image scans, it would be BLOCKED.
